quizPlan.targetEvidence: Full character meanings achievement/merits/success/honor/credit, complete2411590 and actual Daijisen superior-work/meritorious-deed and accumulated-effort effect senses. Do not define 功 as every effort, every neutral result or a money contribution.

distractors.label: add
distractors.decision: Addition/increase/join/include and separate inflict/give sense do not mean merit or achievement. Shared 力 and five strokes make a useful shape contrast.

distractors.label: early childhood; immature
distractors.decision: Childhood/immaturity, also poetical young/innocent, do not mean merit or achievement. Shared 力 and five strokes supply a shape comparison, not etymology.

distractors.label: sword; blade
distractors.decision: A sword/blade, plus reading-restricted scalpel/engraving-tool/knife-money senses, is not merit or achievement. Distinguish the simple hooked outline from 力 in 功; do not identify their shapes or radicals.

directGuards.label: achievements; results
directGuards.reason: Direct achievement overlap, including the selected 功績 family. Neutral or unfavorable 成績 does not erase the shared achievement branch.

directGuards.label: efficacy; effectiveness
directGuards.reason: Daijisen's 功sense2 explicitly includes ききめ/功用; raw効 also has merit. Effectiveness is a defensible alternative for this secondary sense, not a reason to equate every compound.

directGuards.label: fruit; fruition
directGuards.reason: The fruition/achieved-outcome branch overlaps successful accomplishment; the literal fruit branch is unrelated.

directGuards.label: become
directGuards.reason: Conservative reverse-direction guard: 成るsense4 includes succeed/be accomplished and 成功 shares accomplishment. Not a claim that 功 means generic become.

directGuards.label: reach, plural suffix
directGuards.reason: Conservative reverse-direction guard for raw達's accomplished/attain sense and reaching a goal. Achievement can be defensible for that branch; no overlap is claimed with its people-plural suffix.

directGuards.label: victory
directGuards.reason: Victory is a successful achievement; guard the positive-success branch rather than making every success a contest win.

directGuards.label: victory song; triumph
directGuards.reason: The displayed triumph branch can express success/achievement; complete凱歌 includes victory itself, not only a song. No overlap with its separate calm/gentle sense is inferred.

directGuards.label: flourish; glory
directGuards.reason: Raw栄 honor/glory and prosperity overlap 功 honor/credit and successful accomplishment. The separateはえる shine/attractiveness family is not used to invent an allocation.

directGuards.label: respect; honor
directGuards.reason: Conservative displayed-English honor guard against 功's raw honor/credit branch. Honoring someone and having merit are not unrestricted Japanese substitutes.

directGuards.label: work; function
directGuards.reason: Daijisen defines 功 as superior work/働き and the effect of practice; 働く also has work/function/be effective. This broad English work/function label is unsafe as a guaranteed wrong choice, not proof that all labor is meritorious.

directGuards.label: work, occupation
directGuards.reason: The displayed work branch can answer 功's accomplished-work meaning; the distinct occupation and karmic senses are not identified with merit.

directGuards.label: skill; technique
directGuards.reason: Daijisen characterコウsense3 explicitly gives工夫/技術, as in気功. Skill/technique is therefore not guaranteed wrong for every ordinary character sense, despite the card foregrounding merit.

directGuards.label: craft, construction
directGuards.reason: Conservative craft/skill branch guard against the same explicitly documented工夫/技術 character sense. Not an etymological inference from shared 工 shape, nor a claim that every construction is a 功.

proposedTeachingOutline.meaning: 功 concerns merit or achievement: something successfully accomplished or a valued contribution. It can also refer to the effect produced by accumulated work or practice. It does not mean every effort or every neutral result.
proposedTeachingOutline.mnemonic: Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology: picture 工-shaped work beside 力-shaped strength producing an accomplishment. Link existing 工 and 力; keep canonical 力 no.19.
proposedTeachingOutline.readings: Three separate source-order rows. Only コウ selected with its own relative links to 功績/成功. ク andいさお use the exact qualified recognition text above, without unsupported links or invented examples.
proposedTeachingOutline.commonWords: Link 功績こうせき and 成功せいこう, matching their actual primary readings. No new support article or vocabulary level.
proposedTeachingOutline.notes: Contrast 功績's valued achievement/contribution with 成功's success; link 績 for overlapping achievement meaning, not as a wrong answer. Contrast shared力/five-stroke shapes 加/幼 with their distinct add/childhood meanings and 刀's blade outline. Link all substantive existing card comparisons.
